overview-description: Rank climate mitigation actions for your city using this inventory's emissions, your socioeconomic context, regulations and strategic priorities.
inventory-not-found: This inventory could not be loaded. Please pick another inventory or go back to your city page.
step-emissions-description: Review the greenhouse gas inventory that determines each action's potential impact.
step-context-description: Check the socioeconomic indicators that shape which actions fit your city.
step-regulations-description: See which actions are legally blocked or flagged for your municipality.
step-preferences-description: Set the sectors, co-benefits and timeline your city wants to prioritize.
step-policy-description: Review how actions align with national, regional and municipal plans.
step-finance-description: Explore financing routes, opportunities and funded projects per action.
step-preflight-description: Confirm your choices and scoring weights before generating the ranking.
step-placeholder-description: This step's content will appear here.
emissions-description: This greenhouse gas inventory identifies which sectors contribute most to your city's emissions. This data determines the potential impact of each climate action and shapes how actions are ranked.
emissions-ranking-weight: Emissions data shapes 55% of the ranking
emissions-error-body: We couldn't reach the inventory results for this city. Check your connection and try again.
inventories-error-title: We couldn't load this city's inventories
inventories-error-body: The request failed, so we can't tell which inventory to open. This is usually temporary.
sector-afolu: Agriculture, forestry and other land use (AFOLU)

how-ranking-works-description: What the model weighs to rank actions for your city. Explore any area before or after generating recommendations.
